source_edition: Leemans--Liebeck, Chiral polyhedra and finite simple groups, arXiv:1603.07713v3; running header 18 May 2016, internal date 6 November 2018.
principal_contract: Exact positive Theorem1.1 and its chiral-polyhedron consequence in arXiv1603.07713v3
acceptance_roles: Publication_recovery authored the assembly and several components; f003 distinctly reviewed the complete assembly; root adopted it. The component-specific authorship, separate D4 cover and shared field-orientation review boundaries remain exact. This new transport requires an independent operational review.

principal_claims.claim: Theorem1.1: generating x,t, |t|=2, no involutory full-Aut reverser, for simple G outside A7,L2,L3,U3.
Every eligible group is full automorphism group of an abstract chiral polyhedron.

intermediate_corrections: Normalizers of the chosen cyclic subgroup are separately covered in the generating union bound.
Reversers are counted by actual outer cosets and fixed groups, not one assumed involution class; small-field hypotheses remain explicit.
The missing odd-characteristic symplectic unitary overgroup and graph-field coset are included.
Orthogonal projective scalar/spinor losses, full centralizer tori and actual triality multiplicities are corrected.
The false PSU4 special half-bound is replaced by its exact formula and valid uniform quarter lower bound.
ancillary_scope: Only the positive Theorem 1.1 and its chiral-polyhedron consequence are admitted.
PSL2 and A7 negative results remain attributed antecedents, not conclusions of the positive proof.
PSL3/PSU3 nonexistence was announced as forthcoming in this edition and is not promoted to a proved converse.
Historical example types, small-group map counts and the separate O Nan all-types total are not recomputed or imported.
The all-almost-simple extension remains a source question; marked rotation equivalence is not a literal labelled-pair/unmarked-map counting assertion.
